title: An Objective Laboratory Protocol for Evaluating Cognition of Non-Human Systems Against Human Cognition
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research. The protocol is designed to test for general, 'least-common-denominator' human knowledge, and explicitly aims to avoid esoteric topics, which would likely include specific religious or theological knowledge.

measurement_description: The paper proposes a protocol to evaluate general cognitive capabilities of non-human systems against human cognition. It does not measure any aspect of faith or religion.
